integrity: Normalization is probability surface measure. The universal fourth-moment identity and equality characterization are proved analytically; exact finite checks are corroborative. No independent scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The sharp lower coefficient is proved in even ambient dimensions; in odd dimensions strict nonattainment is proved but the sharp coefficient is not determined. Complex quadratic spherical harmonics only. Older equivalent matrix-identity treatments cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp lower fourth moments and Clifford rigidity for complex quadratic spherical harmonics
